plugin.name: rounded-windows
plugin._long: Clips window content to the corner radius from panel-decor and draws an active-window border.

option.name: active_border_width
option._long: Border width in pixels. Zero disables the border without disabling rounded corners.

option.name: active_border_color
option._long: Use auto to follow the active palette accent, or a #RRGGBB color.
